honesty_note: The open-arena outcomes were known before H2 was proposed. This procedure estimates development parameters and performs internal leave-one-colony-out checks; it is not independent validation of H2.
scope: DCM-control 20 cm versus 100 cm approach only

entry_orientation_retention_q.rule: Same q in 20 cm and 100 cm conditions; it may not depend on treatment.

entry_transition_model.definition: With probability q preserve the protocol-sampled post-transition heading; otherwise draw heading uniformly on [-pi, pi).
entry_transition_model.reason: The vertical toothpick transition makes exact heading preservation unsupported. q is shared across treatments so it cannot itself create the short-versus-long effect.
entry_transition_model.H1_boundary: Treatment-specific entry-heading distributions remain forbidden and unresolved; allowing them would turn this into the H1 explanation.

objective.continuous_distance: quantile Wasserstein-1 divided by pooled training SD
objective.aggregation: equal-weight mean squared component distance across both path treatments

nested_models.baseline: Estimate sigma0 and q with H2 effect disabled (rho=0).
nested_models.H2: Estimate sigma0, q, lambda, tau and rho.

cross_validation.comparison: Fit each model on five colonies and score on the sixth with a separate evaluation seed stream.
cross_validation.promotion_guard: H2 must improve held-out loss over the nested baseline in at least 5 of 6 folds and show positive median held-out improvement before any canonical parameter promotion is considered.

identifiability.rule: If lambda and rho form a broad ridge while A200/A1000 are stable, report the amplitudes/ridge rather than a false point estimate.
identifiability.boundary_warning: Parameters repeatedly selected at search bounds are not considered identified.

holdout_rule: The Y-maze remains completely inaccessible to fitting, candidate ranking, stopping rules, and model selection.
canonical_model_rule: Estimation tools write reports only. They may not modify models/lasius_niger_locomotion_h2_v1.json or promote an estimated model automatically.
